note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Go tells the truth, then lets you direct and continue work
purpose: Make Go, the one command that starts or continues work, report exactly who is doing what, so the operator can direct and continue work from the workspace without opening an agent session.
serves: The Project outcome: the operator states intent, and Arcadia drives coding agents and reports back, asking only when it needs a decision.
done_when: You can see Go's real next move in the workspace, send a direction and see it received and acted on, and continue work one Action at a time or through a scope you approved.

actions.title: Tell each agent what it is actually assigned
actions.why: Nothing can be continued safely until Go reports the caller's real assignment, not just the Project's pointer, so no agent works on the wrong thing.
actions.done_when: Go reports a caller's assignment and the Project's selected Action separately, and never invents or takes over ownership.

actions.title: Continue exactly the work Go described
actions.why: Starting work must act on what Go just showed, and pressing Go twice must never start a second agent on the same work.
actions.done_when: Repeating a Go request returns the same Session instead of a new one, and every existing safety check still applies.

actions.title: Show who is working and what needs you, at a glance
actions.why: So you can tell whose work is active and what needs attention from session titles and short updates, without reading a wall of context.
actions.done_when: Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode sessions show their real state in their titles and short acknowledgments.

actions.title: Give the workspace Go's view, with no side effects
actions.why: The workspace needs Go's answer for every Project without each look writing a journal entry or changing anything.
actions.done_when: The workspace reads Go's per-Project answer from a read-only route that changes nothing.

actions.title: Show what happened to your direction
actions.why: When you tell an agent something, you need to know whether it arrived, was read and was acted on, not just that it was saved.
actions.done_when: Each direction shows submitted, delivered, acknowledged, continued and verified only with evidence for each, plus held and unknown.

actions.title: Continue one Action from the workspace
actions.why: This is the first time you can start real work from Arcadia itself, so it has to be one safe press, previewed before it runs.
actions.done_when: A Continue button runs Go's ready Action once after a preview, and one real assisted delivery is completed through it.

actions.title: Let Arcadia keep going through a scope you approved
actions.why: So Arcadia keeps working Action after Action while you're away, and stops at the first thing only you can decide.
actions.done_when: After you approve a scope, Go continues one Action at a time and stops at the first gate with the reason shown.
actions.note: Waits for your answer to the bounded-continuation scope Decision.
